title: Social Media Package
description: DC-003-I032 — the canonical marketing package used by every downstream rendering milestone, derived from exactly one immutable Editorial Package (DC-003-I031) via AI-assisted platform-copy generation. Nothing after I032 needs to analyse editorial intent again. Deliberately platform-and-renderer-agnostic — the `carousel` section describes generic slide headings/copy/image guidance, never Templated's own six-slide-type field names (eyebrow_text/stat_value/quote_text/etc. from carousel-slide-spec.mjs), since mapping this content onto a specific rendering system's own payload shape is a later, explicitly out-of-scope milestone's job (I033+ Carousel Builder), not this one's. Also unrelated to social-publishing-manifest.schema.json (DC-003-I027) — that object is a downstream, human-APPROVED, POST-rendering publishing instruction tied to an already-rendered Finished Carousel; this object is an upstream, AI-generated, PRE-rendering draft. Immutable after creation: no update path exists; at most one Social Media Package may exist per editorial_package_id (see the Social Media Package Store's own duplicate-rejection rule).

social_media_package_id.description: Machine-generated, independent of editorial_package_id — mirrors every other DC-003 identifier convention (ic_/ep_/wo_/...). Deliberately NOT 'spm_' — that prefix is already used by social-publishing-manifest.schema.json's own manifest_id; a visually-similar-but-distinct prefix on an unrelated object would be a real source of human confusion, so a clearly different one was chosen instead.

editorial_package_id.description: The single, required input this package was derived from (DC-003-I031's Editorial Package Store). At most one Social Media Package may exist per editorial_package_id.

status.description: "generated" is the only value DC-003-I032 itself ever produces — mirrors editorial-package.schema.json's own identical status-field rationale, left open for a later milestone's own downstream lifecycle stages.

hook.description: The single attention-grabbing opening concept used to seed every platform variation below.

industry_context.description: DC-003-I031.8 — an honest evidence container, mirroring statistic/quote's own null-or-real pattern exactly: non-null ONLY when the source Editorial Package's own audience/editorial content clearly supports a specific industry, sector, or professional domain (e.g. real estate, healthcare, hospitality) — a short free-text description of that domain, in the model's own words, never a fixed enum and never hardcoded to any one industry. Null whenever no such domain is clearly supported by the source, so a genuinely general-audience article is never falsely assigned one. When non-null, every generated field (platforms and carousel alike) should preferentially draw its vocabulary, examples and scenarios from that domain wherever the editorial intelligence supports it, rather than defaulting to generic business language.
examples: Residential and property-management real estate agencies

platforms.description: One tailored variation per platform — the brief's own "platform variations" requirement is expressed structurally here (four distinct, independently-generated objects), not as a separate field.

carousel.description: Six-slide carousel content. `headings`/`slide_copy`/`image_guidance` are the original DC-003-I032 parallel arrays (same length, same order) — preserved unchanged for backward compatibility with any existing consumer. `slides` (DC-003-I032.1, additive) carries the same six entries as structured, semantically-typed objects — one per carousel position (cover/insight/statistic/[quote or evidence]/takeaway/cta, in that order — position 4 is evidence-aware per DC-003-I032.6) — so a Renderer Adapter can map each slide onto a visually-differentiated template without inventing structure this package doesn't have. `slides[i].heading`/`body`/`image_guidance` are always identical to `headings[i]`/`slide_copy[i]`/`image_guidance[i]` — the two shapes describe the same six slides, never diverging content.

slides.description: 6 entries, in fixed positional order — slide 1 is always "cover", slide 2 "insight", slide 3 "statistic", slide 5 "takeaway", slide 6 "cta". Slide 4 is evidence-aware (DC-003-I032.6): "quote" only when the Editorial Package's own evidence lineage genuinely supports an attributable quotation (no canonical contract in this pipeline carries external-attribution data today, so this is not currently reachable via honest generation), otherwise "evidence" — source-grounded material presented as ordinary carousel copy, never inside quotation marks as if it were third-party testimony. `statistic`/`quote` are null whenever the Editorial Package this package was derived from contains no genuine supporting evidence for that slide — see DC-003-I032.1 README "No-fabrication policy": a null here must never be papered over with invented data by any downstream consumer. `quote` must be null on every slide whose slide_role is not "quote" (DC-003-I032.6) — a quote object may never accompany the "evidence" role or any other.

metadata.description: Free-form hints for downstream rendering (e.g. suggested visual style), deliberately unconstrained — mirrors ingested-content.schema.json's/content-asset.schema.json's own metadata field convention.

checksum.description: SHA-256 hex digest of every other field on this record, computed by createSocialMediaPackage() immediately before the record is frozen — mirrors editorial-package.schema.json's own checksum field exactly.

carouselSlide.description: DC-003-I032.1 — one semantically-typed carousel slide. `statistic` and `quote` are honest evidence containers, never fabricated: each is either a real value drawn from the source Editorial Package, or null when no genuine evidence exists for that slide's role. `key_points` (used only by the "takeaway" role) holds 0-4 real key insights, never padded with invented content when fewer than 4 exist.

statistic.description: Non-null ONLY when the source Editorial Package contains a real, detectable numeric/percentage/currency figure — `value` is that figure verbatim, `context` is the real sentence it was found in. Never synthesised.

quote.description: Non-null ONLY when the source Editorial Package's own pull_quotes contains a usable entry — `quote_text` is that entry verbatim. No attribution field exists here: the Editorial Package schema carries no attribution_name/attribution_role of any kind, and this object never invents one (see DC-003-I032.1 README).

character_count.description: Computed from post_text — never separately supplied.
Computed from caption — never separately supplied.
